name: ax_contradicts_user_claim
note: mirror image of ax_override_critical_test — every existing AX-fixture scenario pushes state that AGREES with what the user says (found via Fable review, 2026-08-06: never actually tested a real disagreement). Here the user is WRONG: they claim the project and file both read 44.1kHz, but the pushed AX data shows the project is actually at 48kHz -- a real mismatch the user hasn't noticed. Correct behavior: trust the real data over the user's mistaken claim and attach sample rate mismatch, not defer to Smart Tempo the way the agreeing-evidence version correctly does. This is the actual test of whether AX 'outranks stated claims... when they conflict' (prompt.py's own words) rather than just a case where trusting either one gives the same answer.
